_comment: The Rogue's retail-style talent trees (format: localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json): a class tree and the
three WotLK specializations, in the order of their talent tabs (Assassinat, Combat, Finesse), which is the
order the bots take them in. Combat is the Crimson Duelist rework (modules/mod-stat-growth's CombatRogue*):
its nodes are the reworked Combat talents, and its kit is only taught while Combat is the specialization.
Other nodes marked existing reuse WotLK talents or name an ability authored in localTools/rogue/Spells.ps1;
the others are generated by localTools/talentTree/TalentRankSpells.ps1 and read by modules/mod-rogue.
Assassinat and Finesse learn 92191, which gives Sinister Strike back its 45 Energy cost (the rework made it
free). botBuild is the order a bot takes its nodes in.
